about: The jobs kept on GitHub's computers, and the few that take another effect, each by repository, workflow file and job (a whole-file entry lists every job id its file holds), with its reason, the decision it rests on and its source. Effects: stay (on a literal GitHub standard label, no setting as its own machine, a CHECKS_RUNNER_<N> handed on only in a step's env; it may hold the write or sign-in it holds there), checks (reads CHECKS_RUNNER_<N> as a change check does, holding only the write it names) and canary (runners' canary.yml alone). machine-rule/judge.mjs reads this file from dazzer-io/.github, never from the repository it judges, and the morning readings read it to leave stay jobs out (r-1.58). machine-rule/README.md says each rule.
